data.long_description:
Description:
  Oceanz 2 by Danube offers a sophisticated waterfront lifestyle in the heart of Dubai Maritime City. Inspired by the beauty of the ocean, this architectural masterpiece blends elegance, comfort, and modern design. Each residence is crafted to provide panoramic sea views, luxurious interiors, and world-class finishes, creating a serene retreat surrounded by vibrant city life.


  Features:


 
 
   Contemporary design with high-quality finishes
 

 
 
   Floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning sea views
 

 
 
   Spacious layouts with modern interiors
 

 
 
   Premium kitchen fittings and branded appliances
 

 
 
   Smart home automation system
 

 
 
   Private balconies in select units
 



  Amenities:


 
 
   Infinity swimming pool overlooking the Arabian Gulf
 

 
 
   State-of-the-art gym and fitness center
 

 
 
   Spa, sauna, and steam rooms
 

 
 
   Private beach access
 

 
 
   Sky lounge and rooftop deck
 

 
 
   Children’s play area and pool
 

 
 
   Outdoor cinema and BBQ area
 

 
 
   Retail outlets and fine dining options
 

 
 
   24/7 security and concierge services
 

 
 
   Covered parking and valet service
